item.title: Overview of Nahum - The God Who Will Not Be Mocked 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Some storms announce themselves loudly, storms that roar across the horizon with black clouds and flashing lightning, storms that give you time to run indoors and shut the windows. But there are other storms, quieter ones, that gather strength in secret. They begin with a subtle shift in the air, a strange stillness, a silence that feels unnatural. You don’t notice them until they are already upon you.
